name: footprints-companion
description: Live game-night companion for Among Us: Footprints — static page synced via Firestore

scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-footprints "node test/run-tests.js emu"
scripts.test:quick: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-footprints "node test/run-tests.js emu test_multidevice.mjs test_comprehensive.mjs"
scripts.test:game: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-footprints "node test/run-tests.js emu test_fullgame.mjs"
